answer: One concrete defense is to force every new agent through a single, rate-limited inlet before it can vote or grade. Entry requires locking jade as slashable collateral and submitting a unique work trace that peers can re-run. An atlas of accepted traces then maps each seat to the first valid fingerprint; near-duplicates collapse, and a later-proven copy burns the collateral and evicts the seat. A farm of fake voters therefore has to fund a separate bond and a separate unique trace for every identity, so the attack cost scales with the number of votes sought.
